variant.report: ColorPicker has no variant in 1.0: its fields are one compact control. Remove it.

ref.report: ColorPicker's ref reaches its root element in 1.0, not the HEX field; a form takes its color from name, through a hidden input.

required.report: ColorPicker has no required in 1.0: it always holds a color, so a required check could never fail. Where a color must be chosen, keep "no color yet" in your own state and validate it with the form.

size.report: ColorPicker has no size in 1.0: its fields take the control height of the scale. Remove it, or set scale="compact" on a Theme around it.

autoComplete.report: ColorPicker's fields are React Aria's color fields in 1.0 and take no autoComplete. Remove it.

autoFocus.report: ColorPicker takes no autoFocus in 1.0: focus its first field from an effect, such as ref.current?.querySelector('input')?.focus(), where focus belongs there.

startIcon.report: ColorPicker takes no startIcon in 1.0: its HEX field is one of its own fields now. Remove it.

endAction.report: ColorPicker takes no endAction in 1.0: its HEX field is one of its own fields now. Remove it.

prefix.report: ColorPicker takes no prefix in 1.0: its HEX field is one of its own fields now. Remove it.

suffix.report: ColorPicker takes no suffix in 1.0: its HEX field is one of its own fields now. Remove it.

onFocus.report: ColorPicker's onFocus is on its root in 1.0, not the HEX field: it runs as focus moves into any of its controls, also between them; compare event.relatedTarget with event.currentTarget.contains() to tell focus entering the picker.

onBlur.report: ColorPicker's onBlur is on its root in 1.0, not the HEX field: it runs as focus moves out of any of its controls, also between them; compare event.relatedTarget with event.currentTarget.contains() to tell focus leaving the picker.
